title: 2025 general budget: all sections
part_text: ‘Underlines the importance for Member States to comply with their commitments, including upholding the right to asylum, and ensuring effective, humane and fair management and protection of the EU’s external borders, as well as effective, safe and dignified reception, integration and return and readmission procedures;’ without the words ‘including upholding the right to asylum,’ ‘and protection of the EU’s external borders’ and ‘and return and readmission procedures’
